workflows.question: 这类能力能继续接线吗，完成到哪里？
workflows.action: Inspect enabled scope and source-qualified acceptance; dormant/excluded metadata does not authorize wiring.

workflows.question: 新增/修正机型身份、别名、类继承
workflows.action: Trace frozen source and binary metadata separately; regenerate derived identities rather than adding UI-local model tables.

workflows.question: 功能已登记但没效果，谁实际执行？
workflows.action: Find the domain consumer file+anchor; follow binding, actual writer/decoder, live admission and stop/release. Registration alone is not consumption.

workflows.question: HC升级后哪些既有消费需复验？
workflows.action: Compare candidate using the existing maintenance planner; review source/ABI/payload differences and preserve original failures. Do not execute all historical test references indiscriminately.

workflows.question: 某个HC方法、初始化或副屏该归哪里？
workflows.action: Inspect source classification plus enabled scope; lifecycle is admitted only where required by an existing enabled consumer.

workflows.question: 优化风扇、体感等高频调用
workflows.action: Keep immutable binding caches, live ownership/freshness checks and equivalent processing workload. Do not add overview JSON lookups, logging or probe work per frame.

workflows.question: 总能力类型、登记数量、验收数量怎么报？
workflows.action: Read dated provenance and recompute changed source facts. Keep source classes, methods, routes, recipes and software test IDs as different units.

workflows.question: 冻结HC不变，如何接入新版机型能力？
workflows.action: Pin official source commit and exact bytes, parse using existing PcCapabilityAudit without HC load, plan changes via existing maintenance, update the same total-library domain rows and original consumers, then rerun only affected original positive/negative/lifecycle scenarios. Source registration is not completion.
